title: Electrical Systems
description: Electrical Systems as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are electrical power, signal and bonding needs of the installation identified?
Are electrical interfaces (connectors, looms, earth points) located in the concept?
Are electrical loads estimated for the power budget?
Are loom routes and connector positions agreed with the installation layout?
Are electrical bonding and earthing paths defined for all metallic items?
Are circuit protection and wire sizing assessed for the preliminary loads?
Are bonding resistance requirements stated and verifiable?
Are all connectors, backshells and clamps specified on the released definitions?
Are electrical test requirements (continuity, insulation, bonding) defined?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
